title: κ = 0.001133508328719775: early resets + kernel re-derived on the R747 bit word (+0.41% over #435)
body:
**Conditional κ = 1133508328719775/10¹⁸ = 0.001133508328719775.** That is +4.08e-7 over #434's current head (0.001133100552284434), +0.414 % over #435 and +1.13 % over #433. The bit supplier binds; #433's split-centre complex supplier (b = 0.001183986549206329) is unchanged.

Stacked on #433. One package, `research/split-centres-kernel-r747/`. The bit word is built in four steps:
1. #433's R758 source-centre word;
2. #434's eleven chronological clean resets (R747), using #434's own reconstruction, vendored;
3. #417's shared-donor response kernel, **re-derived on the R747 word** with #417's discovery tools (40 ILS chains at m = 64): 118 entries, total entrance rank 160, 119 donor slots, no new frames;
4. #386's compressed nine-stage geometry with exact mixed-width bank tiling, as introduced in #435: 727 banks per stage, live stock 14,223, rank deficit 2,496.

| bit word | bit lower |
|---|---:|
| R758 (#433) | 0.001122122700265139 |
| R747 resets (#434 v1) | 0.001129525236098816 |
| R758 + kernel (#435) | 0.001130108533947480 |
| **R747 + kernel re-derived on R747 (this PR)** | **0.001134794627881866** |

**Verification (passed):** `python3 -B research/split-centres-kernel-r747/verify.py /tmp/out` (~30 s, standard library only) → `PASS conditional kappa 0.001133508328719775`. It runs every check from #433, plus the reset reconstruction with its three controls; the kernel stage with exact replay (legality, F₂ on all 987 columns, source spans); the mixed-width bank tiling in `bit_global` and in the independent `bit_audit`, with mutation controls; a fresh finite invoice (226-bit prefix charged at 256); and six bootstrap levels with all 47 strict outer inequalities.
